QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_43

question.text: Reports that a Cat III AIF must submit to SEBI on a QUARTERLY basis include:

answer.text: Activity report (T+10) AND a separate leverage report (T+10)

explanation.text: The Logic: All AIFs file a quarterly activity report within 10 calendar days of quarter-end. In addition, all Cat III AIFs file a separate quarterly leverage report in the pre-defined format. Both filings go to SEBI on the T+10 cadence. The Trap: Audited financials (A) are an annual filing, not a quarterly SEBI report. Investor demographics (C) and PPM changes (D) are not the prescribed quarterly SEBI reports. Note: The two quarterly SEBI reports for Cat III AIFs — activity and leverage — are covered in the workbook on pp. 347 and 352.
